blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Westridge strata homes sit on the slope below Burnaby Mountain, between Barnet Highway on the north and the Hastings Street corridor on the south, on streets including Cliff Avenue, Duncan Avenue and Ridgeview Drive.
Westridge Elementary, at 510 Duncan Avenue, anchors the centre of the neighbourhood the townhome complexes sit in. The school is a School District 41 (SD41) Kindergarten to Grade 7 school.
Barnet Marine Park, at 8181 Barnet Road, is the waterfront park at the bottom of the Westridge slope. The City lists the park on Barnet Road, below the Barnet Highway strata streets.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: The attached stock in Westridge is townhome complexes on the Cliff Avenue, Duncan Avenue and Barnet Highway slope streets, in freehold strata form, with detached houses making up most of the remaining streets. Strata homes in British Columbia are strata lots under the Strata Property Act, each with a share of the complex's common property.
Complex names and years on listing sites were not used.

Newer attached homes here can also be R1 rowhouses on former house lots. Burnaby's R1 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) District permits rowhouses and townhouses on house lots, including fee-simple rowhouse lots of 5 to 8 metres width that are not strata lots.
Rental and pet rules are complex-specific in Westridge.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A Westridge lot near a mountain creek can need a streamside assessment before a strata complex adds or rebuilds.

A suite inside a Westridge strata townhome cannot be stratified off. Burnaby's zoning rewrite states that secondary suites must remain on the same title as the primary unit, and that strata conversion of existing purpose-built rental housing is not permitted except for duplex or semi-detached units.

Tree removal on a sloped Westridge complex lot needs a City permit decision. The City assesses protected-tree removal against its Tree Bylaw criteria, and replacement trees must be shown on the site plan where trees are removed for development.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Westridge Park is at 320 Cliff Avenue, on the same street as the slope's townhome complexes. The City lists Westridge Park among its parks, separate from the waterfront Barnet Marine Park below Barnet Highway.

The Westridge Marine Terminal at 7065 Bayview Drive is an operating oil terminal, not a marina for residents. Trans Mountain's own page describes the terminal as its marine loading facility in Burnaby, at the shore below the Westridge streets.

Barnet Marine Park parking and beach access are on Barnet Road, not through the townhome streets. The City's park page places the park at 8181 Barnet Road, reached from Barnet Highway east of the Westridge slope.
SD41 has no middle-school tier for Westridge children.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: development and new projects

items.t: Burnaby 2050 Official Community Plan (OCP), adopted December 9, 2025, now sets the land use direction for any rezoning proposal on the Barnet Highway and Hastings Street edges of Westridge.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Barnet Highway is the through road along the bottom of the Westridge slope, linking the townhome streets east toward Port Moody and west toward Hastings Street and downtown Vancouver. Barnet Marine Park, at 8181 Barnet Road, sits on that corridor.

Hastings Street is the southern through road for Westridge, with the Brentwood Town Centre town centre west along Lougheed Highway. The City counts Brentwood among its four town centres, and its SkyTrain stations are the rapid-transit option west of Westridge.

Route 136 shows the bus pattern south of the mountain: TransLink runs it from Lougheed Station via Production Way, Forest Grove Drive, Broadway and Halifax Street to Brentwood Station, serving the streets below the Westridge slope.

blocks.text: Westridge Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the streamside area on any Westridge complex backing onto a ravine or creek.
Check title and slope constraints before a strata complex plans retaining-wall or drainage work.

Read the strata's bylaws and depreciation material, not the listing, for rental and pet rules. The Province's strata framework places those rules in each corporation's registered bylaws, with many disputes resolved by the Civil Resolution Tribunal.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Westridge?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 condos and townhomes listed in Westridge. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Westridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Westridge had a sales ratio of 17% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Westridge from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 2 condos and townhomes sold in Westridge over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: Which elementary school serves a Westridge townhome?
faq.a: Westridge Elementary is the in-area school, at 510 Duncan Avenue, Kindergarten to Grade 7 in SD41.

faq.q: What sits below the Barnet Highway townhomes?
faq.a: Barnet Marine Park and the Westridge Marine Terminal both sit on the Burrard Inlet shore below Westridge. The City park is at 8181 Barnet Road, and Trans Mountain, the terminal operator, places the Westridge Marine Terminal at 7065 Bayview Drive, where tankers load at the end of its pipeline system.

No, there is no SkyTrain station in Westridge. The nearest stations are on the Millennium Line south of the slope, including Sperling–Burnaby Lake and Holdom, and TransLink buses on Barnet Highway and Hastings Street connect the Cliff Avenue and Duncan Avenue complexes to those stations and to downtown Vancouver.

faq.q: What does a Westridge strata home pay the City for utilities?
faq.a: A multiple-family dwelling pays the City's 2026 rates of $374.54 for water and $436.00 for sewer use, with a 5% discount if paid by the due date. That City utility notice is separate from the monthly strata fees the townhome complex collects for common property.
